snippet.title: A Whisper Of Fall: Jinyiwei - Gameplay Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
A Whisper of Fall: JinYiWei is a martial arts-themed ARPG game set in ancient China. In the game, You can use your agility to leap between rooftops and vault over walls, engage in a spectacular martial arts duel with your opponent, and even counter every move，experience the grudges and emotional entanglements of the jianghu—the unique world of martial artists. Additionally, in the game, you will be able to use the unique "deduction" ability to travel through time in each sandbox-style level, retrace different scenarios and thus experience the distinctive gameplay of overlapping possibilities.
